description:
Sol QA, regression from T-032. Adding @pytest.mark.skip above an inline test in src/total.py gives touches_tests False, so an agent can skip a test unchecked. The compared test body leaves out decorators (and likely Rust attributes such as #[ignore] above a #[test] fn inside the cfg(test) block is covered, verify).

Fix: inline_test_bodies includes each test unit's decorator lines (Python) and attributes (Rust). Acceptance: adding or removing @pytest.mark.skip / @unittest.skip / #[ignore] on an inline test blocks; a decorator change on a non-test function passes. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Count decorators and markers as part of an inline test
